topic: Municipal solid waste per person, and bin sizes/collection frequency in SLATE cities

findings.what: US municipal solid waste generation per person per day (EPA, most recent standardized figure, 2018 data)
findings.quote: EPA found that the total generation of MSW in 2018 was 292.4 million tons or 4.9 pounds per person per day.
In 2023, total waste from households was equivalent to 377 kg per person

findings.what: England residual (non-recycled) household waste per person, 2024, with 2030 target
findings.quote: Per capita residual waste in England fell from 575kg to 535kg over five years (2019-2024), with a 2030 target of 437kg

findings.what: Ireland managed household waste per person, 2019
findings.quote: The data indicates 320 kilogrammes per person of managed household waste in 2019, up from 314 kg/person in 2018.

findings.what: Ireland total municipal waste per capita, 2018
Ireland municipal waste per capita, 2020 (EPA, via EEA country profile), for comparison with EU-27 average of 520 kg/cap
findings.quote: In 2020, Ireland generated 644 kg/cap of municipal waste, which is significantly above the estimated EU-27 average of 520 kg/cap in the same year.

findings.what: Canada national solid waste disposal per person, 2022 (Environment and Climate Change Canada indicator)
findings.quote: In 2022, national solid waste disposal was 684 kg per person.

findings.what: Canada national solid waste diversion (recycled/composted) per person, 2022
findings.quote: in 2022, national solid waste diversion was 254 kg per person

findings.what: Mexico municipal solid waste (RSU) generation per capita, SEMARNAT Diagnóstico Básico para la Gestión Integral de los Residuos 2026
findings.quote: La generación total de RSU se estimó que equivale a una generación per cápita de 1.076 kilogramos por habitante por día

findings.what: Mexico total national municipal solid waste generated per day (cross-check for per-capita figure above)
findings.quote: México genera 139 mil 902 toneladas diarias de residuos sólidos urbanos

findings.what: Toronto curbside garbage bin sizes and collection frequency
findings.value: 75L/120L/240L/360L carts; garbage collected every other week, Green Bin organics weekly
findings.quote: Garbage is collected every other week for houses using the curbside schedule... garbage and recycling run on alternating weeks.

findings.what: Vancouver garbage cart sizes and collection frequency options
findings.value: 75L/120L/180L/240L/360L carts; resident chooses weekly, every-other-week, or monthly collection
findings.quote: Garbage service can be monthly, every other week, or weekly depending on the cart and service plan you choose.

findings.what: New York City residential trash set-out rules (bins/bags, not a single bin size standard) and collection frequency
findings.value: 1-9 unit buildings: bin up to 55 US gallons (~208 L) with secure lid, set out after 6pm; collection 2-3x/week depending on district; 10+ unit buildings may still use bags set out after 8pm
findings.quote: properties with 1-9 residential units are required to use bins, 55 gallons or less, with secure lids for trash set out

findings.what: London (outer borough example, Ealing) black bin size and collection frequency
findings.value: 180 litres; collected every other week (fortnightly), alongside fortnightly food-waste bin
findings.quote: The standard bin is 180 litres... Your black bin is collected every other week with your small green food waste bin (fortnightly).

findings.what: London (Redbridge) bin size and weekly collection (varies by borough; some keep weekly)
findings.quote: Each wheelie bin holds 180 litres or around three black sacks of rubbish... Recycling and rubbish collections will continue to remain weekly

findings.what: Dublin general waste wheelie bin sizes (private operators, no single municipal service) and collection frequency
findings.value: 45L (apartments) / 120L / 140L / 240L bins; general waste and recycling collected on alternating fortnightly weeks
findings.quote: Standard general waste bin sizes available in Dublin include 45 litres..., 120 litres..., 140 litres..., and 240 litres...; collection frequency is every two weeks on alternating weeks
